name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds Dedicated Server
description: Install the RuneScape: Dragonwilds dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native server binary directly.
known_limitations: OwnerId, ServerName, DefaultWorldName, AdminPassword, and optional WorldPassword are required in the generated DedicatedServer.ini before the server can be used.
The Unreal INI is sectioned and the current GameNode adapter set has no sectioned key/value adapter; the file is therefore documented but not automatically edited.
The dedicated server may rewrite generated metadata and admin lists. Edit it only while stopped.
Automatic updates, backups, and world migration are outside this template.

ports.name: Game
ports.purpose: Dragonwilds dedicated-server port; additional instances use subsequent ports

config_files.description: Windows Unreal server settings including OwnerId, ServerName, DefaultWorldName, AdminPassword, and WorldPassword.
Linux Unreal server settings including OwnerId, ServerName, DefaultWorldName, AdminPassword, and WorldPassword.

requirements.description: Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required by the official setup guide.
The reviewed Windows and Linux builds target x86-64 hosts.
Ensure sufficient storage for the server build and world saves.

help.summary: GameNode installs SteamCMD App ID 4019830 and launches the native Windows or Linux Dragonwilds server binary.
notes: Set OwnerId to the player's in-game Player ID before the first usable start.
Forward UDP 7777 for the first instance; later instances use subsequent ports.
The current Steam tool supports anonymous installation according to the official Jagex guide, although some deployments may require a licensed Steam login.

findings.summary: Dragonwilds uses a sectioned Unreal DedicatedServer.ini; GameNode's current safe INI adapter is intentionally sectionless.
The server will not start as usable without the owner's in-game Player ID in OwnerId.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers during installation
An amd64 Windows or Linux host
A Dragonwilds Player ID for OwnerId
